exit: 15:45 on the trading session before expiry; first valid subsequent in-session snapshot if unavailable
capital_rule: 3 times initial underlying notional per independently funded cohort
exploratory_policy: garch_long_short with a predeclared early-exercise-risk close rule; not a broker assignment simulation
selection: Available call/put quotes at the origin's 09:45 snapshot; nearest eligible expiry, then nearest paired strike to the observed stock midpoint
reporting: Independent cohorts and normalized trade outcomes; no portfolio Sharpe from overlapping tenors

data_handling_sensitivity.name: zero_bid_writedown
data_handling_sensitivity.added_after: Observed liquidation failures caused by published zero bids, before interpreting aggregate strategy P&L
data_handling_sensitivity.rule: Long unbid legs are valued at zero with an explicit do-not-exercise/abandonment commitment, not recorded as executed sales. A short leg can close against an observed positive ask even if its bid is zero.

greek_missing_quote_policy: Prefer the current opposite-leg IV for same-strike/same-expiry missing-leg deltas; otherwise a previous valid IV for at most four days. No future data used.
